flags.why: The use of nhiêu in nhiêu đó is mainly Southern and lacks a regional tag.
Dí also commonly means to press or thrust something close to or against someone or something.
flags.fix: Add: to press or thrust something close to or against; example: Anh ta dí súng vào đầu tôi. = He pressed a gun against my head.

flags.why: The example mentions the word đụ instead of using it as a verb meaning to have sex.
flags.fix: Anh ta chỉ muốn đụ chứ không muốn yêu. = He only wants to fuck, not to love.

flags.why: Chọi meaning to throw something at a target is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional tag.
